isolated_delta.guard: active_decisions < 20 AND tile_share < 0.20 AND incoming_threat_count = 0 AND territory_not_collapsing

unchanged: all behavior after decision twenty or at twenty-percent land share

success_metrics.opening: candidate final tiles at decision 20 and decision 50 exceed the exact parent in both seat parities
success_metrics.finish: candidate shows mirrored placement and tile advantage at episode finish

stop_conditions: any unexplained hold or rejected decision
any harmful action against a K1Z identity
any source, image, request, or runtime hash mismatch
